metadata.description:
NamespaceMetadataMetadata holds the labels and annotations provided for a
namespace through a NamespaceMetadata file.

annotations.description: Annotations to be applied to the namespace.

labels.description: Labels to be applied to the namespace.

title: NamespaceMetadata is a KRM-style configuration object that allows tenants to provide additional metadata for the namespaces managed by an ArtifactGenerator.
